purpose: Verify PMS-AFR-070: Assigning a Director to a RESUBMITTED application restarts the review cycle.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN assigns an eligible Director to the RESUBMITTED application.
expected_result: Application moves to UNDER_REVIEW and a new review cycle starts.

purpose: Verify PMS-AFR-080: Attorney acceptance of an offered assignment moves the application to ATTORNEY_ASSIGNED.
preconditions: Application exists in ASSIGNMENT_OFFERED status with an offered Attorney assignment.

purpose: Verify PMS-AFR-081: Attorney decline of an offered assignment moves the application to PENDING_REVIEW for reassignment.
preconditions: Application exists in ASSIGNMENT_OFFERED status with an offered Attorney assignment.
expected_result: Application moves to PENDING_REVIEW awaiting PCC_ADMIN reassignment.
